symptom_cluster: Sharp central chest pressure, radiating pain to left arm or jaw, acute shortness of breath, sudden cold sweats, palpitations, crushing chest tightness, lightheadedness
clinical_rationale: Classic presentation of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), myocardial ischemia, or malignant cardiac arrhythmias requiring immediate emergency evaluation and ECG/troponin workup.

symptom_cluster: Persistent itchy skin rash, chronic eczema, inflammatory cystic acne, changing pigmented moles with irregular borders, chronic hives, sudden localized swelling, severe scaling
clinical_rationale: Cutaneous lesions, chronic inflammatory skin disorders, and dysplastic nevi require direct visual and dermoscopic inspection by a skin specialist to rule out malignancy or chronic dermatitis.

symptom_cluster: High infant fever, persistent ear pulling, chronic earaches, delayed speech or motor milestones, childhood wheezing, pediatric asthma attacks, routine vaccination tracking
clinical_rationale: Infants, children, and adolescents exhibit unique physiological baselines and developmental trajectories that demand specialized pediatric expertise for proper management.

symptom_cluster: Severe symmetrical joint pain, morning stiffness lasting over an hour, chronic lower back stiffness, swollen finger joints, restricted spinal mobility, systemic fatigue, inflammatory arthritis
clinical_rationale: Persistent joint inflammation paired with prolonged morning stiffness strongly correlates with autoimmune pathologies like rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, or systemic connective tissue disorders.

symptom_cluster: Chronic burning heartburn, frequent acid reflux, severe postprandial abdominal pain, unexplained rapid weight loss, chronic constipation or diarrhea, hematochezia, dark tarry stools
clinical_rationale: Upper and lower GI symptoms coupled with alarm features like weight loss or gastrointestinal bleeding mandate specialized endoscopic and colonoscopic evaluation.

symptom_cluster: Recurrent throbbing headaches, chronic migraines with visual aura, unexplained vertigo, sudden numbness or tingling in limbs, focal weakness, acute seizure episodes, progressive short-term memory lapses
clinical_rationale: Focal neurological deficits, recurrent migraine patterns, or unexplained paresthesias require diagnostic neuroimaging and central/peripheral nervous system assessments.

symptom_cluster: Persistent overwhelming anxiety, chronic sadness, debilitating panic attacks, extreme mood swings, severe insomnia, intrusive thoughts, profound loss of interest in daily activities
clinical_rationale: Behavioral health crises, clinical mood disorders, and anxiety states benefit from psychiatric evaluation alongside specialized pharmacological or structured psychotherapeutic intervention.

symptom_cluster: Chronic nasal congestion, persistent sinus pressure, recurring sore throats, muffled hearing, chronic ear infections, persistent hoarseness, swallowing difficulties, tonsillar swelling
clinical_rationale: Localized structural pathologies affecting the ears, nose, and upper throat tract require specialized optical instruments and localized intervention.

symptom_cluster: Frequent excessive thirst, unexplained frequent urination, blurry vision, slow-healing skin cuts, chronic fatigue, unexpected weight fluctuations, blood sugar spikes
clinical_rationale: Symptom clusters of polyuria and polydipsia suggest metabolic dysregulation, diabetes mellitus, or thyroid axis imbalances requiring hormonal panels.

symptom_cluster: Painful urination, blood in urine, recurring urinary tract infections, lower flank pain, foamy urine, decreased urine output, chronic kidney stone discomfort
clinical_rationale: Renal and urinary tract irregularities require targeted urinalysis, structural imaging, and glomerular filtration rate tracking.
